title: Electric Ireland Home Electric+ Standard Smart Tariff Price Plan, price schedule valid as of 1 November 2024: day, night and peak unit rates, the published band hours, and urban and rural annual standing charges
used_for: D27's three-band time-of-use plan: the only part of the card that carries PUBLISHED band hours (Day 08:00-23:00 excluding peak, Night 23:00-08:00, Peak 17:00-19:00) and a published peak rate. The 2022 standard price schedule states no band hours at all, so this is also where the day/night plan's night window comes from - a CROSS-PLAN carry, flagged as such in export/tariffs. VINTAGE: this schedule is dated November 2024 and the simulated year is 2022. A three-band domestic smart tariff was not a published plan in May 2022, so there is no contemporaneous sheet to use; the mismatch is recorded on the dataset rather than hidden. Exposure `none`, as above.
